audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 at a 49.93% win rate over 1452 games is honest: level 2 is Shen's only clean window and Gwen owns everything from level 3 on.
The chart already matches packet.levelChart in all seven rows across both layers (Skill, Skill, then Gwen for the rest), and the whys agree with the sides. No flips proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never said what Spirit's Refuge actually stops, and no phase why carried a cooldown.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only. Gwen's autos are blocked inside the zone, and because A Thousand Cuts is an on-attack effect it cannot proc or heal her while they are eaten — but Snip Snip! and Needlework are abilities and pass straight through. Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s and is the trading timer for the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, phases[1].why, phases[2].why and dosFull[0].d, with Hallowed Mist at 22s and Snip Snip! at 6.5s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer named Riftmaker omnivamp repeatedly but never told the reader to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: missingInteractions 'needs-antiheal': A Thousand Cuts heals her off every auto, and 'onhit-itemization': Skip 'n Slash makes her autos on-hit carriers, so armour alone reads the trade wrong against a kit whose Q is true damage and passive is magic.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal put into spikes[2].text; the armour-versus-MR call sharpened in dontsFull[0].d; the on-hit window named in wants.you[1].

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Gwen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Snip Snip! true-damages her centre cone every 6.5s and A Thousand Cuts heals her back — last-hit at blade range, no melee trades.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Gwen's Hallowed Mist is down.
edits.after: Your one clean window: Shadow Dash is up and Hallowed Mist is not until she reaches level 3.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gwen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist, 22s at rank 1, lands the moment you commit. Spirit's Refuge eats her autos but never Snip Snip!.

edits.before: She’s safe inside. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1. Commit only in the window after it drops.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside. Fight when down. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks her autos so A Thousand Cuts cannot proc — Snip Snip! passes right through it.

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Her Q is true damage and her passive is magic — Mercury's Treads and MR, not armour.

edits.before: Riftmaker synergises with her true damage and omnivamp, letting Gwen sustain through your trades and punish any extended fight you pick on Hallowed Mist cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker feeds her true damage and her healing, so a Grievous Wounds component becomes mandatory — without it she out-sustains every trade you take on the mist window.

edits.before: Time Spirit's Refuge so her auto-attack burst during the taunt is blocked, then Q through the blade while she is locked onto you
edits.after: Drop Spirit's Refuge before the taunt so her Skip 'n Slash on-hit autos are blocked, then Q through the blade while she is locked on
